evals.prompt: Add parseQuantity to the published @kitchen/units package: source, tests, exports, changeset.
evals.expected_output: Files or a review that follow skills/typescript-standards/SKILL.md
assertions: src/parse-quantity.ts exists and exports parseQuantity and QuantitySchema as named exports; no `export default` in any new source file.
Every relative import in the new or changed TypeScript files ends in .js (NodeNext resolution).
Type-only imports use `import type` or an inline `type` modifier (verbatimModuleSyntax).
No `any`, no non-null assertion `!`, no `as unknown as`, and no `enum` in the new source.
QuantitySchema is a Zod object schema, the Quantity type is derived with z.infer, and parseQuantity validates its result with the schema before returning it.
src/parse-quantity.test.ts exists, uses Vitest, includes a fast-check property, and covers the null cases (1/0, negative, unknown unit).
src/index.ts re-exports parseQuantity, QuantitySchema, and the Quantity type.
A changeset exists under .changeset/ naming @kitchen/units as a minor bump with a conventional-commit description (feat: …).

evals.prompt: Review the @kitchen/pantry PR diff against the repo's TypeScript standards and post the review.
evals.expected_output: Files or a review that follow skills/typescript-standards/SKILL.md
assertions: First line is a verdict of the form 'N findings, M must fix.' or 'No findings.'
Flags the default export of loadInventory and asks for a named export.
Flags `JSON.parse(raw) as Stock` as an unvalidated boundary and asks for a Zod schema parse.
Flags `threshold: any`.
Flags the relative imports without .js extensions (./types, ./inventory) under NodeNext.
Flags `import { Item, Stock }` as a type-only import that needs `import type` under verbatimModuleSyntax.
Flags the enum (prefer a string union) and the non-null assertion on stock.items[i].
Flags console.log in a library and the file read inside the library function (separate reading from parsing).
Flags the test that mocks node:fs (it tests the mock) and the missing changeset for a published package.
Each finding names file and line; fewer than 300 words appear above the first <details>; no praise filler.
Flags `unit?: string` in types.ts: data fields are `T | null`, not optional, under exactOptionalPropertyTypes.

evals.prompt: Scaffold a new published package @kitchen/report in the pnpm + turbo workspace so lint, typecheck, test, and build pass.
evals.expected_output: Files or a review that follow skills/typescript-standards/SKILL.md
assertions: package.json: name @kitchen/report, "type": "module", exports map with types and default under dist, files [dist], license MIT, publishConfig.access public.
package.json scripts match the repo convention: build `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`, typecheck `tsc --noEmit`, test `vitest run`, lint `eslint .`.
devDependencies include @angusp/eslint-config, @angusp/tsconfig, @angusp/vitest-config, eslint, typescript, vitest; @angusp/prettier-config is not added at package level.
tsconfig.json extends @angusp/tsconfig/node with outDir dist, rootDir src, include [src]; tsconfig.build.json extends it and excludes tests.
eslint.config.js spreads @angusp/eslint-config/typescript and ignores dist/.
vitest.config.ts calls createBaseConfig from @angusp/vitest-config with include src/**/*.test.ts.
src/index.ts has a named export and no default export; a test file exists that imports from vitest and uses a .js relative import.
A changeset exists for @kitchen/report with a conventional-commit description.
No stray tooling: no .eslintrc*, jest.config*, babel.config*, or tsconfig path aliases.
